title: ‘Intention of accused was to kill’: Cops on Gurgaon hit-and-run case; 2 arrested
content: Police stated the accused intended to kill the woman biker. Video footage showed the accused deliberately rammed his car into her bike. The sections pertaining to attempt to murder were added based on the victim's statement. The accused fled to Rajasthan after his media statement and was arrested. Police have arrested Kalyan Singh Bainsla and his cousin Lavish in connection with the case.

title: After 3,300 job cuts, Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi has a promise for customers
content: Uber has cut about 3,300 jobs, nearly 10% of its global workforce, and CEO Dara Khosrowshahi says riders could see lower Uber ride prices as a result. At the Goldman Sachs conference, he said savings from the layoffs and falling insurance costs will fund cheaper fares, better selection and growth, even as Waymo robotaxis tighten US competition. The reorganisation also strips out management layers and nearly all remote roles.

title: Meet Aaryan Shukla, 16, world’s No. 1 human calculator with 9 Guinness records
content: Aaryan Shukla stands out as the foremost human calculator globally, gaining fame as a young Indian prodigy. With several Guinness World Records and two Mental Calculation World Cup titles to his name, his journey commenced at the age of six. By twelve, he secured his position as a world champion, demonstrating the impact of rigorous mental exercises and motivating others amidst the concerning trend of dwindling math skills among students.

title: India’s exports jump 25.4% in August, narrowing overall trade deficit to $9.41bn
content: India's overall trade deficit narrowed to $9.41 billion in August 2026. Exports grew 25.41% year-on-year to $82.68 billion, while imports rose to $92.09 billion. Merchandise exports increased 26.12% to $43.81 billion, showing strong performance. Services exports also registered robust growth, contributing to the positive trend. This export momentum accelerated further, indicating a positive trade outlook.

title: Fake cancer drugs and ICU injections sold at 50% off, and hospitals bought them
content: Recent investigations in Bengaluru and Delhi have uncovered the alarming distribution of counterfeit medications in various hospitals. These incidents expose serious vulnerabilities in the pharmaceutical supply chain, revealing diverted cancer treatments originating from government hospitals. The issue encompasses more than just manufacturing flaws; it concerns the entire journey of drugs from suppliers to patients. Employing robust technology and verification processes is essential to curtail future instances of fake-drug rackets.

title: Josh Duhamel turned 52 Minnesota acres into an off-grid family retreat
content: Actor Josh Duhamel has acquired a tranquil property in Minnesota, initially featuring just an old cabin. Over the years, he expanded the land to fifty-two acres, modernizing it with essential utilities like electricity and running water. This transformation has provided a beloved retreat for his family, where they can enjoy a range of outdoor activities, including leisure time by the lakeside with his son.

title: Wisconsin family’s 2,000 floodplain acres now permanently protected
content: A nearly 2,000-acre former farm along Wisconsin’s Sugar River is now permanently protected after years of drainage efforts and a tax dispute. Groundswell Conservancy and Ducks Unlimited bought the property, which includes wetlands, floodplain forests and prairies. The land will become part of the Avon Bottoms Wildlife Area and remain open for hiking, fishing, hunting and wildlife watching.

title: Nvidia, Palantir tell Anthropic, OpenAI: Stop 'stealing' our data or we ban you
content: Palantir, Nvidia and Booz Allen Hamilton are restricting how employees use Anthropic and OpenAI's advanced AI models, and want guarantees that proprietary company data will not be retained or used for training. The trigger is Anthropic's 30-day data retention policy, introduced in June with Claude Fable 5. Palantir is holding out for irrevocable zero data retention, Nvidia is routing sensitive work to its own Nemotron models, and Anthropic has answered with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.

title: Woman spends a night inside the real Conjuring house: ‘You didn’t feel alone’
content: A horror enthusiast recounted her bizarre overnight adventure at the infamous Conjuring House, a nearly 300-year-old farmhouse in Rhode Island that inspired the renowned film series. She described the atmosphere as unsettling and 'sickening,' creating an intense discomfort for anyone inside. With a notorious history of paranormal events, the location fascinates thrill-seekers, though it is currently closed for repairs and public access.

title: Sagrada Familia gets 24-tonne ‘glue job’ ahead of architect’s centenary
content: The Sagrada Familia continues to rise with the aid of cutting-edge technology and unique adhesive solutions that bond stone with steel, reinforcing its many panels. This modern construction effort employs digital modeling and off-site prefabrication to expedite the building process, all while contending with environmental factors like salinity and underground vibrations. The ongoing project remains a testament to the spirit of innovation and teamwork in contemporary architecture.

title: Ohio may add 118 acres around rare wetland, growing preserve to 450 acres
content: Ross County officials support a proposed 118-acre land acquisition for wetland protection.  This acquisition would significantly expand the buffer around Kinnikinnick Fen and Herron Downs.  Funding through Ohio’s Clean Ohio program is crucial for this conservation effort.  The property owners have also offered to donate their house and surrounding land.  This project aims to create a larger, connected protected habitat for the region.

title: 'Police action was delayed': Gurgaon biker Sia after arrest of accused
content: Sia, a motorcyclist, alleged delayed police action after her vehicle was hit on Golf Course Road.  The car driver, Kalyan Bainsla, was arrested from Rajasthan two days later.  Sia had posted a video of the incident, showing the car intentionally hitting her.  Her brother stated the police handled the investigation promptly and efficiently.  He refuted defense claims that the incident was accidental or for social media attention.

title: Rupee falls 0.4% to 95.96 against dollar, sharpest single-day drop in two months
content: The Indian rupee experienced its sharpest single-day fall in two months. Rising oil prices and higher US interest rate expectations pressured the currency. Attacks on Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure boosted crude oil prices significantly. The Reserve Bank of India's dollar sales helped limit the rupee's losses. Bond yields rose as inflation and rate-hike bets grew.

title: Tendulkar's ODI record broken: Zimbabwe's Brendan Taylor makes history
content: Taylor's ODI career now spans 22 years and four months, moving him ahead of Tendulkar, whose ODI career lasted 22 years and three months before he retired from the format in 2012.

title: ‘Will show reality’: CJP’s Saurabh Das brings ‘School Theek Karo’ to Noida
content: The Cockroach Janta Party initiated its 'School Theek Karo' campaign in Noida city. Party spokesperson Saurabh Das announced plans for a comprehensive school audit. Young people across Uttar Pradesh are encouraged to inspect their neighborhood schools. This social audit drive focuses on government schools and basic facilities. Findings will document infrastructure and essential amenities for children's education.

title: ‘They were doing stunts, racing’: Gurgaon hit-and-run accused's lawyer blames biker
content: The lawyer for accused driver Kalyan Bainsla stated bikers were racing and performing stunts. He argued the Golf Course Road incident was a case of negligence, not hit-and-run. Police arrested Bainsla and added an attempt-to-murder charge to the FIR after a video went viral. Bainsla, a gym owner, denied deliberately hitting the woman biker. The lawyer claimed both parties were at fault in the high-speed collision.

title: Theodore Roosevelt’s 1901 swearing-in reenacted in same Buffalo room 125 years later
content: On September 14, 1901, Theodore Roosevelt became US president in the library of Ansley Wilcox’s Buffalo home after William McKinley died. For the 125th anniversary, the Theodore Roosevelt Inaugural Site recreate the ceremony in the same room. Actor Joe Wiegand portray Roosevelt, arriving in Buffalo by train before taking the 35-word presidential oath.

title: Texas landowners sue to stop border work through Big Bend under $46bn federal push
content: In a bold stand for their land and legacy, Texas landowners and conservationists are taking legal action against the Trump administration's border wall efforts. They emphasize that the Big Bend area, known for its natural beauty, has minimal illegal crossing incidents. The lawsuit contests the rationale behind sidelining environmental protections and raises alarms about potential harm to both private properties and local ecosystems.

title: Why Alia Bhatt has been sending emails to daughter Raha since birth
content: Alia Bhatt composes heartfelt monthly emails to her daughter Raha, filled with cherished photos and videos. This digital diary serves as a vibrant keepsake, capturing memories for the future. When Raha reaches fifteen, Alia intends to unveil this treasure trove of moments, including delightful interactions with family, showcasing how parents often perceive their children as forever young.

title: 110 years since tanks entered the battlefield; how they have evolved
content: Tanks have undergone significant transformation, evolving from basic trench-crossing vehicles to critical components of combined-arms warfare. In World War Two, they became the backbone of armored formations, while Cold War innovations led to the development of main battle tanks for vast combat scenarios. Today, amidst modern warfare complexities involving drones and precision anti-tank weaponry, tanks are utilized effectively at smaller unit levels, providing essential firepower and infantry support.

title: Video shows Indian-origin woman, friend 'laughing' moment before NYC train hit them

Investigators are exploring multiple theories regarding their presence on the tracks.  Possible factors include an attempt to help a friend or intoxication.  The medical examiner has not yet released an official determination.

title: 'This was my last World Cup': Bhuvneshwar reveals why India return hopes faded

He admitted feeling deserving of another opportunity while stressing it is not his sole motivation. The veteran pacer has accepted his current omission from the national squad. Bhuvneshwar sensed his 2022 World Cup career might have concluded after the semifinal loss.

title: Indians in UK, US return on high visa costs, immigration issues; but to lower pays

title: ‘29 Sept tak metro mein safar na karein’: Multiple Delhi schools receive bomb threats
content: Several Delhi schools received bomb threats via email on Monday morning. The emails also threatened blasts targeting courts and police stations across the capital. Security forces launched extensive searches at affected school premises and other locations. Bomb disposal squads and sniffer dogs were deployed to ensure safety. Fire tenders and ambulances remained on standby as a precautionary measure.

title: ‘Bhagne nahi dunga’: Himanshu Bhau claims responsibility for Delhi gym trainer murder

Police are verifying the social media post and investigating the gangster's alleged involvement. The attack may be linked to an old family rivalry which has claimed lives. No arrests have been made as authorities conduct raids to trace suspects.

title: Motivational quote of the day by Lady Gaga
content: Lady Gaga's artistic journey has transformed from a focus on shock value to a mission of spreading love and positivity. In an age dominated by social media, her art resonates deeply, emphasizing that creativity can inspire without necessarily shocking. Her powerful message transcends entertainment, reaching diverse audiences and various professional fields, reminding us all of the importance of love and connection in our lives.
